name: Greenlandic law: the legislation published in Nalunaarutit (Greenlandic acts, forordninger and bekendtgørelser; Danish acts and anordninger for Greenland; treaties), with the Church Act and the Port Dues Act replayed change by change

dates.time: 12:00 America/Nuuk (UTC-3, UTC-2 in summer time, until 25 March 2023; UTC-2 until 30 March 2024; since then UTC-2, UTC-1 in summer time)

scope.when_absent: a commit without Applies: records no scope note; the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: no retroactive criminal liability; no general bar elsewhere
default_reach.meaning: an act applies from the day it takes effect; an act may give itself effect from an earlier day (an amending act says so: "har virkning fra ..."), except that no one is punished for an act that was not punishable by law when it was done
default_reach.authority: Kriminallov for Grønland (lov nr. 306 af 30. april 2008) § 1 (the legality principle) and Article 7 of the European Convention on Human Rights; Danmarks Riges Grundlov, which applies in Greenland, contains no general rule on retroactive legislation. Not quoted here: the wording was not read from an official source in this build

label: Greenland
record_note: kirken/ and havneafgift/ are replayed change by change; every other folder holds the official texts Nalunaarutit publishes (the act as passed and each consolidation), with amending acts recorded on their in-force day in aendringslove/ and repeals on the repealing act's in-force day.
verification: Each version file set equals the Nalunaarutit page word for word (one file per section where the split reproduces the page, else one file hele-teksten.md).
